title: 00585 - P16DE/005854
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Fuel pressure or fuel delivery issues
stepByStepSolution: Visually inspect and Değiştirin / Yenileyin: spark plugs if necessary
Inspect Emme system for leaks and repair as needed
Kontrol edin:  and verify correct fuel pressure and delivery quantity
Inspect and clean or Değiştirin / Yenileyin: fuel injectors
Kontrol edin:  ignition coils, swap coils location to see if the fault code changes
technicalNotes:
As per the Factory Repair manuals:
This fault code sets when a specific cylinder runs too lean, causing an imbalance in the air-fuel mixture and engine roughness."
Fault may be more prevalent in conditions such as:
Engine speed between 1,240 – 2,240 RPM
Engine load between 39.80 – 99.80%
Cylinder head ECT > 60°C
Modeled catalyst temperature between 450 – 850°C
Lambda control in closed-loop operation
No rough road detected
Integrated air mass within 1.70 – 3.50 kg range
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
